name: 48661 · West Branch, MI
findings: ZIP 48661 (West Branch) has 47 nonprofit organizations. 20 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 13 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 48661 (West Branch) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
25% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 48661 (West Branch) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.9 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 12 organizations here; 49% of all organizations here have no identified type.
